name: Otobe Shizuka
source:
Boss of the Otobe Group.
Second year student at Masumi Private Girls' Academy. The only daughter of the former boss of the Otobe Group.

She lost her parents a few years ago and became the boss of the Otobe Group.
The group changed direction significantly during her father's time, and became a group beloved by the local community, operating as a "handyman," and Shizuka has continued that policy to this day.

She doesn't particularly want to be called "boss" and aims to be a graceful and mature woman, but sometimes her bossy nature shows through.
She admires casino dealers that she saw in movies when she was young, and belongs to the "Magic Club" at school.
(She thinks that handling cards might be useful.)

She wants to treat Fuyuko as a normal friend, but Fuyuko tries to distance herself from her, so she is always trying to find ways to break that distance.
As the daughter and granddaughter of the boss, she respects Rio, who is steadily achieving her goals.
